sec.clues.sub: Read what hides under a block
sec.parts.sub: Borrowed arms, legs and a tail
lesson.start.title: Pick your start
lesson.start.text: The city is under quarantine. Tap any block: your Command Center lands there and the first resident steps out. Nothing dangerous spawns right next to it.
lesson.start.tip: Starting near the middle leaves more room to build.
lesson.dig.title: Clear blocks
lesson.dig.text: Swipe across closed blocks. Free residents walk over and clear them, and the ring shows the work left. Every block gives 5 Energy.
lesson.dig.tip: Tap a queued block to remove it.
lesson.clue.title: A number counts neighbors
lesson.clue.text: A number on an open block tells how many things hide in the 8 blocks around it. A red number means nests and hero lairs. Tap the number and the game lights up its neighbors.
lesson.clue.tip: A block with no number means nothing is nearby: all its neighbors are safe to dig.
lesson.deduce.title: Work it out
lesson.deduce.text: This 1 has only one closed neighbor, so the nest is there. The next 1 has now found its nest, so its other neighbors are safe. The scanner puts a green check on them.
lesson.deduce.tip: A check means dig away. A red mark means danger.
lesson.build.title: Build your base
lesson.build.text: Open Build, pick a building and tap a glowing tile. A resident walks over and builds it. A Microreactor then makes Energy by itself, and a School trains every resident at once.
lesson.build.tip: Microreactor first, then a School: Energy flows on its own and residents get tougher.
lesson.fight.title: Residents fight on their own
lesson.fight.text: There's no separate army: every resident digs and fights. When an enemy comes close, nearby residents drop their work, fight, then go back to digging. Tap an enemy to send everyone there.
lesson.fight.tip: A new resident appears at the Command Center every 12 seconds while there are fewer than 10.
lesson.parts.title: Trophies make you stronger
lesson.parts.text: The resident who lands the final blow takes the enemy's arm or leg and fits it right away. A cryo adaptant gives a cryogel arm, a thermo one a thermo arm. A hero drops two parts at once.
lesson.parts.tip: Fight heroes from weak to strong: the weak ones give parts that make the strong ones easier.
clue.threat.name: Red number ▲
clue.threat.text: How many adaptant nests and hero lairs are among the 8 neighboring blocks. Open one and enemies come out.
clue.finds.name: Cyan number ◆
clue.finds.text: How many useful finds are nearby: Energy caches and survivors. Worth digging.
clue.many.name: Several numbers
clue.many.text: If both nests and finds are near, a block shows small numbers in the corners: cyan left, red right, purple bottom.
clue.empty.name: Empty block
clue.empty.text: No number means nothing nearby: all neighbors are safe and the scanner checks them. Which to dig is up to you.
clue.safe.name: Green check
clue.safe.text: The scanner proved from the numbers there's no nest or lair here. Dig away.
clue.danger.name: Red hotspot mark
clue.danger.text: The scanner proved there's a nest or a hero lair here. Swipes skip this block. To open it, tap the mark and confirm.
clue.caution.name: Your caution flag
clue.caution.text: Hold your finger on a closed block to flag it as suspicious. Swipes leave it alone.
clue.scanner.name: HeroOut scanner
clue.scanner.text: A drone that marks only what follows for certain from the numbers. It never guesses. On Normal it runs on the Scan button: 3 charges, one more every 60 seconds.
clue.accident.name: Opened a nest by accident
clue.accident.text: Opening a nest is not a loss. A fight starts, and the game highlights the number that warned you about it.
res.energy.text: The only resource. Comes from every cleared block, caches, energy veins, rubble, nests and heroes. Microreactors make it by themselves, no workers needed. Spent only on buildings.
res.energy.how: Energy flies to the Command Center as an orb and counts when it lands.
res.residents.text: A new resident appears at the Command Center every 12 seconds while there are fewer than 10. You start with two. Every resident digs, builds and fights.
res.threat.name: Threat
res.threat.text: The red ring in the corner. Every 2 minutes threat rises: enemies get tougher, nests spawn faster, their parts get stronger. Unopened heroes eventually come out by themselves.
people.resident.how: An enemy within 3 blocks of a resident or building: nearby residents drop their work and fight, and go back 3 seconds after the fight. Tap an enemy to send everyone there.
people.ranks.name: Ranks
people.ranks.text: Rank depends only on trophies: Recruit, Veteran (1–2), Shift Hero (3–4), Legend (5–6).
parts.how.name: How trophies work
parts.how.text: Many enemies wear a borrowed body part. The resident who lands the final blow takes it and fits it at once. If the slot is taken, it replaces a weaker part. A spare part is recycled into Energy.
parts.slots.name: Slots
parts.slots.text: Six slots: two arms, two legs, a tail and wings. Arms add damage and an element, legs add speed and health, wings and tails come only from heroes.
parts.tech.text: The trophy matches the enemy's element, and every part protects its owner from that element.
part.thermo_arm.text: Hits set the target burning for 3 more seconds.
part.volt_arm.text: The charge jumps to a nearby enemy.
part.runner_leg.text: Run faster, more health. From ordinary adaptants.
part.piston_leg.text: Lots of health and armor. From heavy adaptants.
part.drill_tail.text: A powerful area hit. Only from the Demon.
enemy.adaptant.how: They leave the nest and head for the nearest building or resident. Almost half carry a part you can take.
enemy.adaptant.techs: Elements: thermo (orange), cryogel (blue), volt (yellow), toxin (green). Each is weak to its predator on the element cycle.
enemy.heavy.how: One per nest; a new one comes out 30 seconds after the last falls. Always drops a trophy, one tier higher.
enemy.nest.how: Releases 3 adaptants at once, then one every 4 seconds while fewer than 8 are alive. Destroy the nest to stop the flow: +40 Energy.
enemy.demon.how: Raises its drill tail before a steam blast. The jet reaches 3 tiles ahead and leaves hot ground. You win when the Demon is down and the ground has cooled.
enemy.hatch.how: Open it when the squad is ready. Wait too long and the Demon comes out by itself at minute 15, with a one-minute warning.
map.rubble.how: Mark it with a swipe: residents clear it in 24 seconds for 30 Energy.
map.vein.how: Mark it with a swipe: two residents mine 1 Energy every 2 seconds, 120 in total.
map.water.how: Can't walk or build here. Plan a path around.
map.survivor.how: Joins the base at once as a new resident.
ctrl.tap.name: Tap
ctrl.tap.text: Your first tap places the Command Center. Tap a number to light up its neighbors. Tap a queued block to remove it.
ctrl.swipe.name: Swipe
ctrl.swipe.text: Drag a finger or the mouse across blocks to queue them for clearing. Known hotspots and your flags are skipped.
ctrl.hold.name: Hold
ctrl.hold.text: On a closed block, sets or removes a caution flag. On a building or a creature, shows a tooltip.
ctrl.order.name: Tap an enemy
ctrl.order.text: Residents fight on their own. Tap an enemy, a nest or a hero and all residents nearby go there. Tap empty ground to cancel.
ctrl.build.name: Build
ctrl.build.text: The button at the bottom. Pick a building, tap a glowing tile, confirm with the check.
ctrl.keys.name: Keyboard
ctrl.keys.text: Space pauses, Esc cancels a selection, right click removes a block from the queue.
ctrl.pause.name: Pause
ctrl.pause.text: While paused you can plan digs and buildings; they start when you resume. Online games have no pause.
world.city.name: Lumen City
world.city.text: A sunny coastal city of the future: white towers, rooftop gardens, a monorail. After the catastrophe its blocks were sealed under quarantine.
world.heroout.name: HeroOut
world.heroout.text: An emergency-care corporation. It supplies the city with rescuers, prosthetics and swappable body parts. To HeroOut a body is just a carrier.
world.splice.name: Splice Medium
world.splice.text: A medical carrier that negotiates with foreign tissue. It's why an arm, a leg or a tail can be transplanted here. No magic.
world.catastrophe.name: The catastrophe
world.catastrophe.text: At a demo of the EVERYONE IS ON CALL protocol, Splice Medium got into a reactor. The rescue network became a network of runaway adaptation.
world.adaptants.name: Adaptants
world.adaptants.text: Citizens Splice Medium rebuilt for someone else's task. Not evil, they just can't stop.
world.control.name: Control
world.control.text: HeroOut's voice on the air. Politely reminds everyone that all residents are company assets.
world.you.name: You
world.you.text: The shift coordinator. Your job: open the city, gather residents and stop the hero the call is about.
coach.clue.name: NUMBERS
coach.build.name: BUILDING
coach.fight.name: COMBAT
coach.parts.name: TROPHIES
coach.threat.name: THREAT
coach.threat.title: Threat went up
coach.threat.text: Every 2 minutes enemies get tougher and their trophies stronger. Don't stall: collect parts and go for the call target.
coach.finds.name: FINDS
coach.finds.title: Cyan number
coach.finds.text: An Energy cache or a survivor is nearby. Clear this number's neighbors.
cap.command_up: Command Center up, a resident steps out
cap.one_closed: Only one is closed: the nest is there
cap.overlap: This number's nest is already found
cap.tap_enemy: Tap an enemy: residents go there
cap.nest_open: Nest open: the fight is on
cap.finds: Cyan number: a find is nearby
lesson.elements.title: The element cycle
lesson.elements.text: Every arm has an element. Volt beats Cryogel, Cryogel beats Thermo, Thermo beats Toxin, Toxin beats Impact, Impact beats Volt. A resident picks the arm that hurts the target most.
lesson.elements.tip: An enemy barely feels its own element, while its predator on the cycle hits one and a half times harder.
lesson.call.title: Emergency call
lesson.call.text: Every shift is a call on one of HeroOut's heroes gone mad. Purple numbers lead to its lair. Defeat it and the shift is closed. Red numbers also hide other heroes' lairs: optional, but they drop strong parts.
lesson.call.tip: Don't stall: enemies grow tougher every 2 minutes, heroes come out on their own at minutes 4, 8 and 12, and the call target at minute 15.
clue.boss.name: Purple number ⬢
clue.boss.text: The lair of the hero you were called on is among the 8 neighbors. There's only one on the map.
bld.command.text: The heart of the base and where residents appear. If it falls, the shift is lost.
bld.home.text: A second place where residents appear, closer to the work, and a shelter for three. Doesn't change how many residents you have.
bld.reactor.text: Makes 1 Energy every 3 seconds by itself. No worker needed.
bld.cooler.text: Neighboring microreactors work twice as fast. Two stations don't stack.
bld.school.text: Trains every resident at once: each school gives +10 health, +2 damage and +0.5 armor, up to three schools. Also expands your territory.
parts.heroes.name: Hero parts
parts.heroes.text: A hero drops two parts: the arm to whoever finished it, the leg, wings or tail to whoever dealt the most damage after them. Hero parts carry the hero's ability.
part.toxin_arm.text: Hits poison the target and lower its armor.
elem.cycle.name: The element cycle
elem.choose.name: Residents choose
elem.choose.text: Before every hit a resident picks the arm that hurts this target most. So your residents' arms decide a hero fight.
elem.resist.name: Element protection
elem.resist.text: Each part of an element cuts damage of that element to its owner by 12 % per tier. A resident with a thermo arm barely minds steam.
elem.mult.name: Multipliers
elem.mult.text: Strong weakness ×1.5, weakness ×1.25, normal ×1, resistance ×0.75, strong resistance ×0.5. Bare hands hit everyone the same.
elem.reactions.name: Reactions
elem.reactions.text: Two elements in a row on one target trigger a strong effect. That's why mixing arms pays off.
hero.call.name: Emergency call
hero.lairs.name: Hero lairs
hero.lairs.text: Each map has three hero lairs: a weak, a medium and a strong hero. Leave them closed and they come out at minutes 4, 8 and 12. Optional, but their parts help a lot in the main fight.
hero.allies.name: Allies
hero.allies.text: Meet a hero's condition and it comes back to your side. Before a shift, take unlocked heroes along: 1 slot at first, 2 after 5 unlocked, 3 after 10. An ally fights by itself and buffs the whole shift.
ability.standard: Comes as three copies, each with a third of the health.
ability.patch: Very fast: steals flying Energy orbs and runs off.
ability.canopy: Every 10 seconds grows thickets that slow residents.
ability.current: A 3-tile jet pushes residents back and washes off their buffs.
ability.lineman: Every 7 seconds pulls a resident in with a cable and stuns them.
ability.frostline: Every 6 seconds a cone kick: damage and chill.
ability.mason: Props up supports across streets and blocks residents' paths.
ability.sweep: Every 8 seconds a steam cloud burns residents around.
ability.beacon: A signal flare makes nearby nests spawn twice as fast.
ability.hive: A drone swarm stings up to four residents and poisons them.
ability.kiln: Every 8 seconds a 3-tile charge: heavy damage and knockback.
ability.seraph: Heals other enemies nearby and flies over water. Hit her first.
ability.doctor: Every 10 seconds injects gel into the nearest enemy: tougher and healing.
ability.demon: Raises its tail and blasts steam 3 tiles ahead, leaving hot ground.
ability.n73: Takes over a resident for 6 seconds: they fight their own.
enemy.lair.how: Open it when your residents are ready. Otherwise the hero comes out alone: weak at minute 4, medium at 8, strong at 12.
enemy.boss.how: The call target: Kiln, Seraph, the Doctor or the Demon. Comes out at minute 15 with a one-minute warning. Defeat it and the shift is closed.
world.heroes.name: Heroes gone mad
world.heroes.text: Fifteen HeroOut rescuers went mad and keep "rescuing" people by their protocol. Defeat a hero and it can come back to your side.
coach.hero.name: HERO
coach.hero.title: A hero is out
coach.hero.text: A hero gone mad is heading for the city. Gather your residents and tap it. Winning drops two strong parts.
coach.call.name: CALL
coach.elements.name: ELEMENTS
cap.drop_tools: Enemy close: residents drop their work
cap.hero_out: A hero comes out of its lair
cap.picks: Mix elements: someone has the right one
coach.call.title: The call target is waking
coach.call.text: In a minute the hero you were called on comes out by itself. Gather residents with the best arms and meet it. Winning closes the shift.
coach.elements.title: Elements
coach.elements.text: Arms have elements. Volt beats Cryogel, Cryogel beats Thermo, Thermo beats Toxin, Toxin beats Impact, Impact beats Volt. Residents pick what to hit with.
